name: oma-one-hackathon-prototype
description: OMA ONE — защищённый full-stack PWA-пилот с PostgreSQL

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && node dist/scripts/copy-static.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch dist/server.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright install --with-deps chromium && playwright test
scripts.test:proof: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/proof-engine.test.js dist/tests/proof-api.test.js dist/tests/engine.test.js dist/tests/ios-evidence-bundle.test.js dist/tests/ios-native-static.test.js dist/tests/ui-static.test.js dist/tests/shelf-flow.test.js dist/tests/home-twin.test.js dist/tests/finance-domain.test.js dist/tests/banking-provider.test.js
